reason: The $24.99 launch price is about what I'd risk on an impulse, and the named lab report plus the money-back guarantee make it less likely to end up in my drawer of half-used bottles. I'd only buy one box, not two.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I have a drawer full of bottles that did nothing, and I'd have to take all 30 sachets before I can ask for my money back.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I trust showing real use over a few weeks, or a refund that does not require finishing all 30 sachets.
